facts.fact: Countdown to 2030's analysis of DHIS2 facility data reports that the share of expected monthly facility reports received nationally (mean of antenatal, delivery, immunisation and outpatient forms) rose from 86% in 2019 and 93% in 2023 to 96% in 2024, districts at 90% completeness or more from 66% to 93%, and the annual data quality score from 80 to 91, which it attributes to sustained investment in digital systems, staff capacity, supervision and data quality dashboards.

systems.tiers: not stated; holds monthly reports from health facilities, analysed by district and region

note: The document publishes reporting completeness and data quality for 2019-2024 but states nothing on who keys the reports, which tiers use the system, or its governance; the completeness series is carried in the one last12 fact. It notes internet outages and delayed data entry in remote areas as possible causes of gaps, without a date.
